script.message: "Chained shut. From the OUTSIDE. Through the bars the road is empty: no rickshaws, no tea stall lights."

script.body:
"ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
Student identity card

Dept. of CSE. The name is smeared with something dark and the photo has been scratched away, as if by fingernails.

The lanyard is still knotted around something under the sheet."
script.dark_message: "Too dark to read. Light the lantern."
script.title: "A student ID on a lanyard"
